Best place for shawarma wraps full stop. Hit the spot food!
Jun 2023 • Solo
I have travelled the world and have had great shawarmas but this one tops it. Here I usually order the beef shawarma and it never disappoints. The fries make a nice side, crispy on the outside and you get a nice combo meal here with a free drink that includes a generously sized shawarma, fries and a drink of your choice. The beef is succulent, juicy, the extra fillings like herbs, spices and sauces really bring out the flavour. All in all excellent. If you are feeling especially hungry you can get the fatboy shawarma, which is massive. The price is very reasonable. The shawarma (beef) combo is about 150k VND ($5) and the fatboy alone is the same price. It's worth it. They also do chicken shawarma, which is just as good and little cheaper than the beef one. On top of this are hummus dishes as well. It's a no brainer. IF you are hungry and need good, fresh, filling food that hits the spot every time, then come here. The owner is Egyptian and is very friendly. He is an expert shawarma chef, plus he makes the wrap from scratch everyday.

Soggy Kebab
Feb 2019
I visited kebab station on my first night in Ho Chin Minh City. It is on Walking Street in district 1.

First impressions was that it was your standard take away. They sell beers although it is a halal establishment. 

They have arcade machines on the side of the wall. I didn’t check about the toilets.

I ordered a chicken kebab wrap with chips. The chips were anaemic and the chicken was dry. They had included a lot of salad in the wrap but it was very soggy. I ended up removing most of it.

I was very disappointed ☹️. Very overpriced food (100K) for a terrible meal.
